questions.prompt: The company will hire more __________ to deal with customer complaints.
questions.explanation: 语法上，空格作 hire 的宾语，需要名词。语义上，公司招聘更多“员工/人员”处理投诉。常见搭配：company personnel / military personnel。

questions.prompt: Children often have a powerful __________ and can create stories from simple objects.
questions.explanation: 语法上，形容词 powerful 后接名词。语义上，孩子有强大的“想象力”，能从简单物品创造故事。

questions.prompt: I respect your opinion, but I must __________ with your conclusion.
questions.explanation: 语法上，must 后接动词原形。语义上，说话人尊重对方观点，但“不同意”结论。常见搭配：disagree with someone / disagree with an opinion。

questions.prompt: After shouting for two hours, he had a sore __________.
questions.explanation: 语法上，形容词 sore 修饰名词。语义上，大喊两小时后“喉咙”痛。常见搭配：a sore throat。

questions.prompt: The report offers useful __________ into how teenagers use social media.
questions.explanation: 语法上，offers useful 后接名词。语义上，报告提供关于青少年使用社交媒体的“洞察/见解”。常见搭配：insight into something。

questions.prompt: The government needs to __________ the problem of youth unemployment.
questions.explanation: 语法上，needs to 后接动词原形。语义上，政府需要“处理/解决”青年失业问题。常见搭配：tackle a problem / issue / challenge。

questions.prompt: Some people believe that true friendship can last __________.
questions.explanation: 语法上，空格修饰动词 last，需要副词。语义上，真正的友谊可以“永远”持续。

questions.prompt: The cost of the project should not __________ the original budget.
questions.explanation: 语法上，should not 后接动词原形。语义上，项目成本不应“超过”原预算。常见搭配：exceed the budget / limit / speed limit。

questions.prompt: Public __________ on education has increased sharply this year.
questions.explanation: 语法上，形容词 Public 后接名词。语义上，教育方面的公共“支出”今年大幅增加。常见搭配：public expenditure / government expenditure。

questions.prompt: She cried with __________ when she heard that she had passed the exam.
questions.explanation: 语法上，介词 with 后接名词。语义上，听到通过考试后，她喜极而泣。常见搭配：cry with joy / tears of joy。

questions.prompt: The doctor advised the __________ woman to avoid heavy lifting.
questions.explanation: 语法上，空格修饰名词 woman，需要形容词。语义上，医生建议“怀孕的”女性避免搬重物。

questions.prompt: We need a more __________ source of information before making a decision.
questions.explanation: 语法上，空格修饰名词 source，需要形容词。语义上，做决定前需要更“可靠的”信息来源。常见搭配：a reliable source / reliable information。

questions.prompt: Remember to bring your camping __________, including a tent and a sleeping bag.
questions.explanation: 语法上，bring your camping 后接名词。语义上，帐篷和睡袋属于露营“装备”。常见搭配：camping gear / sports gear。

questions.prompt: To open the file, simply __________ on the icon twice.
questions.explanation: 语法上，祈使句中用动词原形。语义上，打开文件需要双击图标。常见搭配：click on an icon / click twice。

questions.prompt: The famous __________ wrote many poems about nature and loneliness.
questions.explanation: 语法上，形容词 famous 后接名词。语义上，写诗的人是“诗人”。

questions.prompt: He made a __________ by investing in technology companies early.
questions.explanation: 语法上，冠词 a 后接名词。语义上，他早期投资科技公司赚了一大笔“财富”。常见搭配：make a fortune。

questions.prompt: The award __________ will be held in the school hall on Friday.
questions.explanation: 语法上，名词 award 修饰另一个名词。语义上，颁奖“典礼”将在学校礼堂举行。常见搭配：award ceremony / graduation ceremony。

questions.prompt: There was a huge __________ of books on the teacher’s desk.
questions.explanation: 语法上，冠词 a 和形容词 huge 后接名词。语义上，老师桌上有一大“堆”书。常见搭配：a pile of books / a pile of papers。

questions.prompt: The farmer keeps cows, chickens, and one small __________.
questions.explanation: 语法上，数词 one small 后接可数名词单数。语义上，农场养了牛、鸡和一只小“猪”。

questions.prompt: The drink is a strange __________ of fruit juice, milk, and ice.
questions.explanation: 语法上，冠词 a 和形容词 strange 后接名词。语义上，这种饮料是果汁、牛奶和冰的奇怪“混合物”。常见搭配：a mixture of A, B and C。

questions.prompt: The lights turn on __________ when someone enters the room.
questions.explanation: 语法上，空格修饰动词短语 turn on，需要副词。语义上，有人进入房间时，灯会“自动地”打开。

questions.prompt: The university invited a famous __________ to give a lecture on ancient history.
questions.explanation: 语法上，形容词 famous 后接名词。语义上，大学邀请著名“学者”做古代史讲座。

questions.prompt: Long-term stress can cause serious __________ problems.
questions.explanation: 语法上，空格修饰名词 problems，需要形容词。语义上，长期压力会造成严重“心理的”问题。常见搭配：psychological problems / psychological effects。

questions.prompt: House prices have risen __________ in the past ten years.
questions.explanation: 语法上，空格修饰动词 risen，需要副词。语义上，房价在过去十年“显著地”上涨。常见搭配：rise dramatically / change dramatically。

questions.prompt: The investors have a large financial __________ in the company.
questions.explanation: 语法上，形容词 financial 后接名词。语义上，投资者在公司有很大的经济“股份/利益”。常见搭配：have a stake in something。

questions.prompt: Scientists discovered a tiny sea __________ living near the rocks.
questions.explanation: 语法上，形容词 tiny sea 后接名词。语义上，科学家发现一种小型海洋“生物”。

questions.prompt: The two schools formed a __________ to share teaching resources.
questions.explanation: 语法上，冠词 a 后接名词。语义上，两所学校建立“合作关系”来共享教学资源。常见搭配：form a partnership。

questions.prompt: Student __________ in class discussions is part of the final grade.
questions.explanation: 语法上，名词 Student 修饰后面的名词。语义上，学生课堂“参与”是期末成绩的一部分。常见搭配：student participation / participation in something。

questions.prompt: Read every __________ in the contract before you sign it.
questions.explanation: 语法上，every 后接可数名词单数。语义上，签合同前要阅读每一个“条款”。常见搭配：a clause in a contract。

questions.prompt: Drivers who park illegally may have to pay a heavy __________.
questions.explanation: 语法上，形容词 heavy 后接名词。语义上，违停司机可能要支付高额“罚款”。常见搭配：pay a penalty / a heavy penalty。

questions.prompt: The king entered the private __________ to meet his advisers.
questions.explanation: 语法上，形容词 private 后接名词。语义上，国王进入私人“房间”会见顾问。

questions.prompt: Do you __________ going out for dinner tonight?
questions.explanation: 语法上，助动词 Do 后接动词原形。语义上，fancy doing something 表示“想要做某事”。常见搭配：fancy going out / fancy a drink。

questions.prompt: Many students find modern __________ difficult but beautiful.
questions.explanation: 语法上，形容词 modern 后接名词。语义上，学生觉得现代“诗歌”难但美。

questions.prompt: We had a short __________ after class about the homework.
questions.explanation: 语法上，冠词 a 和形容词 short 后接名词。语义上，下课后简短“聊天”。常见搭配：have a chat about something。

questions.prompt: Warm __________ is necessary if you are hiking in winter.
questions.explanation: 语法上，形容词 Warm 后接名词。语义上，冬天徒步需要保暖“衣物”。

questions.prompt: Languages continue to __________ as society changes.
questions.explanation: 语法上，continue to 后接动词原形。语义上，语言会随着社会变化继续“发展/演变”。

questions.prompt: She stayed quiet for the __________ of peace.
questions.explanation: 语法上，固定表达 for the sake of。语义上，她为了和平保持沉默。常见搭配：for the sake of peace / safety / convenience。

questions.prompt: Put the dictionary back on the top __________ after using it.
questions.explanation: 语法上，形容词 top 后接名词。语义上，用完词典后放回最上面的“架子”。常见搭配：on the shelf。

questions.prompt: The new policy is expected to __________ economic growth.
questions.explanation: 语法上，is expected to 后接动词原形。语义上，新政策预计会“促进”经济增长。常见搭配：boost growth / confidence / sales。

questions.prompt: The dog wagged its __________ when it saw its owner.
questions.explanation: 语法上，所有格 its 后接名词。语义上，狗见到主人时摇“尾巴”。常见搭配：wag its tail。

questions.prompt: The police found stolen goods in his __________.
questions.explanation: 语法上，介词 in 后接名词。语义上，警方在他“拥有/持有”中发现赃物。常见搭配：in someone’s possession。

questions.prompt: The law on __________ remains controversial in many countries.
questions.explanation: 语法上，介词 on 后接名词。语义上，关于“堕胎”的法律在很多国家仍有争议。

questions.prompt: Young children are naturally __________ about the world around them.
questions.explanation: 语法上，are naturally 后接形容词。语义上，小孩天生对世界“好奇”。常见搭配：be curious about something。

questions.prompt: They sat around a __________ table in the old kitchen.
questions.explanation: 语法上，空格修饰名词 table，需要形容词。语义上，他们坐在一张“木制的”桌子旁。

questions.prompt: The city experienced an economic __________ after the new airport opened.
questions.explanation: 语法上，形容词 economic 后接名词。语义上，新机场开放后，城市经历经济“繁荣”。常见搭配：economic boom。

questions.prompt: My grandfather told us a strange __________ about a mountain spirit.
questions.explanation: 语法上，冠词 a 和形容词 strange 后接名词。语义上，祖父讲了一个关于山神的奇怪“故事/传说”。

questions.prompt: Citizens in a __________ society should have the right to vote.
questions.explanation: 语法上，空格修饰名词 society，需要形容词。语义上，在“民主的”社会中，公民应有投票权。

questions.prompt: Regular __________ can prevent machines from breaking down.
questions.explanation: 语法上，形容词 Regular 后接名词。语义上，定期“维护”可以防止机器故障。常见搭配：regular maintenance。

questions.prompt: The roads were icy; __________, many flights were delayed.
questions.explanation: 语法上，空格作句子副词，连接前后因果。语义上，道路结冰，因此许多航班延误。常见搭配：consequently, …。

questions.prompt: She boiled some water in a large __________.
questions.explanation: 语法上，形容词 large 后接名词。语义上，她用大“锅”烧水。

questions.prompt: The farmer milked the __________ early in the morning.
questions.explanation: 语法上，冠词 the 后接名词。语义上，农民早上给“奶牛”挤奶。

questions.prompt: Exercise can help __________ your muscles and bones.
questions.explanation: 语法上，help 后接动词原形。语义上，运动可以帮助“增强”肌肉和骨骼。常见搭配：strengthen muscles / relationships / arguments。

questions.prompt: He read a book __________ waiting for the train.
questions.explanation: 语法上，空格连接两个动作，作连词。语义上，他“在”等火车的时候读书。whilst 比 while 更正式。

questions.prompt: Lack of time is the biggest __________ on our research project.
questions.explanation: 语法上，形容词最高级 biggest 后接名词。语义上，缺少时间是研究项目最大的“限制”。常见搭配：a constraint on something。

questions.prompt: Please __________ the letter before putting it into the envelope.
questions.explanation: 语法上，祈使句用动词原形。语义上，把信放进信封前需要“折叠”。常见搭配：fold a letter / fold clothes。

questions.prompt: Throw the empty bottle into the recycling __________.
questions.explanation: 语法上，名词短语 recycling bin。语义上，空瓶应扔进回收“垃圾箱”。常见搭配：rubbish bin / recycling bin。

questions.prompt: The patient will __________ surgery next week.
questions.explanation: 语法上，will 后接动词原形。语义上，病人下周将“接受/经历”手术。常见搭配：undergo surgery / treatment / training。

questions.prompt: This mistake could __________ damage the company’s reputation.
questions.explanation: 语法上，空格修饰动词 damage，需要副词。语义上，这个错误可能会损害公司声誉。常见搭配：potentially dangerous / potentially harmful。

questions.prompt: The study is limited in __________ and only covers three cities.
questions.explanation: 语法上，介词 in 后接名词。语义上，这项研究“范围”有限，只覆盖三个城市。常见搭配：limited in scope / the scope of a study。

questions.prompt: Children sometimes __________ to be doctors, teachers, or superheroes.
questions.explanation: 语法上，sometimes 后接动词原形作谓语。语义上，孩子有时“假装”成医生、老师或超级英雄。常见搭配：pretend to be someone。

questions.prompt: Cultural __________ makes the city more open and interesting.
questions.explanation: 语法上，形容词 Cultural 后接名词。语义上，文化“多样性”让城市更开放有趣。常见搭配：cultural diversity。

questions.prompt: Several newspapers __________ that the minister accepted illegal payments.
questions.explanation: 语法上，主语 Several newspapers 后接动词原形作谓语。语义上，报纸“声称”部长收受非法款项。常见搭配：allege that…。

questions.prompt: She felt great __________ after completing the marathon.
questions.explanation: 语法上，形容词 great 后接名词。语义上，完成马拉松后她感到强烈“自豪”。常见搭配：feel pride / take pride in something。

questions.prompt: The athletes trained under __________ pressure before the final.
questions.explanation: 语法上，空格修饰名词 pressure，需要形容词。语义上，决赛前运动员承受“强烈的”压力。常见搭配：intense pressure / intense competition。

questions.prompt: The police launched an __________ into the missing documents.
questions.explanation: 语法上，冠词 an 后接名词。语义上，警方对丢失文件展开“调查”。常见搭配：launch an inquiry into something。

questions.prompt: The manager decided to __________ after the scandal became public.
questions.explanation: 语法上，decided to 后接动词原形。语义上，丑闻曝光后经理决定“辞职”。常见搭配：resign from a job / resign as manager。

questions.prompt: It takes years to master the __________ of writing good fiction.
questions.explanation: 语法上，冠词 the 后接名词。语义上，写好小说的“技艺/手艺”需要多年掌握。常见搭配：master the craft of writing。

questions.prompt: The school has __________ rules about mobile phone use.
questions.explanation: 语法上，空格修饰名词 rules，需要形容词。语义上，学校对手机使用有“严格的”规定。常见搭配：strict rules / strict discipline。

questions.prompt: We need __________ evidence, not just guesses or feelings.
questions.explanation: 语法上，空格修饰名词 evidence，需要形容词。语义上，需要“具体的/确凿的”证据，而不是猜测和感觉。常见搭配：concrete evidence / concrete examples。

questions.prompt: The child picked up a beautiful __________ on the beach.
questions.explanation: 语法上，冠词 a 和形容词 beautiful 后接名词。语义上，孩子在海滩捡到一个漂亮“贝壳”。

questions.prompt: It would be __________ to save some money before leaving your job.
questions.explanation: 语法上，It would be 后接形容词。语义上，辞职前存一些钱是“明智的”。常见搭配：be wise to do something。

questions.prompt: The two products look similar, but there are several __________ differences.
questions.explanation: 语法上，空格修饰名词 differences，需要形容词。语义上，两个产品相似，但有几个“明显的/不同的”差异。常见搭配：distinct differences / distinct features。

questions.prompt: A good sense of __________ can make difficult situations easier to handle.
questions.explanation: 语法上，介词 of 后接名词。语义上，良好的“幽默感”能让困难情况更容易处理。常见搭配：a sense of humor。

questions.prompt: The main __________ of this method is that it takes too much time.
questions.explanation: 语法上，形容词 main 后接名词。语义上，这种方法主要“局限”是耗时太多。常见搭配：the limitation of a method。

questions.prompt: Dark clouds are usually an __________ of possible rain.
questions.explanation: 语法上，冠词 an 后接名词。语义上，乌云通常是可能下雨的“迹象”。常见搭配：an indication of something。

questions.prompt: Political __________ is important for long-term economic development.
questions.explanation: 语法上，形容词 Political 后接名词。语义上，政治“稳定”对长期经济发展重要。常见搭配：political stability / economic stability。

questions.prompt: Parents should not __________ their children’s emotional needs.
questions.explanation: 语法上，should not 后接动词原形。语义上，父母不应“忽视”孩子的情感需求。常见搭配：neglect someone’s needs / duties。

questions.prompt: Mozart began to __________ music when he was very young.
questions.explanation: 语法上，began to 后接动词原形。语义上，莫扎特很小就开始“创作”音乐。常见搭配：compose music / compose a song。

questions.prompt: The criminal was sent to __________ for five years.
questions.explanation: 语法上，介词 to 后接地点名词。语义上，罪犯被送进“监狱”五年。常见搭配：send someone to jail。

questions.prompt: Many critics __________ the decision as irresponsible and unfair.
questions.explanation: 语法上，主语 Many critics 后接动词原形作谓语。语义上，批评者“谴责”该决定不负责任且不公平。这里 damn 是较强烈用词，正式写作中一般可替换为 condemn。

questions.prompt: The charity provides food and __________ for homeless people.
questions.explanation: 语法上，food and 后接并列名词。语义上，慈善机构为无家可归者提供食物和“庇护所”。常见搭配：provide shelter for someone。

questions.prompt: A __________ apology is not enough if no real change follows.
questions.explanation: 语法上，空格修饰名词 apology，需要形容词。语义上，“仅仅”道歉不够，还需要真正改变。常见搭配：a mere apology / a mere child。

questions.prompt: Trees absorb __________ dioxide from the air.
questions.explanation: 语法上，名词短语 carbon dioxide。语义上，树木吸收空气中的“二氧化碳”。常见搭配：carbon dioxide / carbon emissions。

questions.prompt: The government should __________ the sale of dangerous chemicals.
questions.explanation: 语法上，should 后接动词原形。语义上，政府应该“监管”危险化学品销售。常见搭配：regulate the sale/use/industry。

questions.prompt: Would you like extra __________ on your sandwich?
questions.explanation: 语法上，形容词 extra 后接名词。语义上，三明治里加额外“奶酪”。

questions.prompt: Loud noises can __________ anxiety in some animals.
questions.explanation: 语法上，can 后接动词原形。语义上，巨大噪音会“引发”一些动物的焦虑。常见搭配：trigger anxiety / trigger a reaction。

questions.prompt: Water flows through a long metal __________ under the street.
questions.explanation: 语法上，形容词 metal 后接名词。语义上，水通过街道下的金属“管道”流动。

questions.prompt: The earthquake caused widespread __________ across the city.
questions.explanation: 语法上，形容词 widespread 后接名词。语义上，地震造成大范围“破坏”。常见搭配：cause destruction / widespread destruction。

questions.prompt: He learned to play the __________ by watching online videos.
questions.explanation: 语法上，play the 后接乐器名词。语义上，他通过在线视频学会弹“吉他”。常见搭配：play the guitar。

questions.prompt: Each country’s __________ was raised during the opening ceremony.
questions.explanation: 语法上，所有格 country’s 后接名词。语义上，开幕式上升起每个国家的“旗帜”。

questions.prompt: She practises the __________ for an hour every evening.
questions.explanation: 语法上，practises the 后接乐器名词。语义上，她每天练一小时“钢琴”。常见搭配：play/practise the piano。

questions.prompt: The children watched the __________ show with great excitement.
questions.explanation: 语法上，空格修饰名词 show，形成名词短语。语义上，孩子们兴奋地观看“魔术表演”。常见搭配：magic show / magic trick。

questions.prompt: The cause of the accident remains a __________.
questions.explanation: 语法上，冠词 a 后接名词。语义上，事故原因仍是一个“谜”。常见搭配：remain a mystery。

questions.prompt: We plan to __________ in the mountains during the winter holiday.
questions.explanation: 语法上，plan to 后接动词原形。语义上，他们计划寒假去山里“滑雪”。

questions.prompt: Please do not __________ during the test.
questions.explanation: 语法上，祈使否定句 do not 后接动词原形。语义上，考试期间不要“低语”。

questions.prompt: Passengers should leave the bus through the __________ door.
questions.explanation: 语法上，空格修饰名词 door，需要形容词。语义上，乘客应从“后面的”门下车。常见搭配：rear door / rear window。

questions.prompt: The restaurant has added several vegetarian dishes to the __________.
questions.explanation: 语法上，介词 to 后接名词。语义上，餐厅在“菜单”上增加了几道素食菜品。

questions.prompt: Many animal __________ are disappearing because of habitat loss.
questions.explanation: 语法上，形容词 animal 后接名词。语义上，由于栖息地丧失，许多动物“物种”正在消失。注意 species 单复数同形。

questions.prompt: The __________ looked especially bright above the sea.
questions.explanation: 语法上，冠词 The 后接名词作主语。语义上，海面上方的“月亮”特别明亮。

questions.prompt: He is late again, __________ because the traffic is heavy.
questions.explanation: 语法上，空格作句子副词，表示推测。语义上，他又迟到了，大概是因为交通拥堵。常见搭配：presumably because…。
